condition: one explicitly authorized remote repository, provider, deployment, or configuration action is requested

dependency_records.rationale: AI telemetry extends a configured release-observability boundary when the product contains model calls.
APM enablement uses an installed provider agent when that adapter is selected.
Web deployment requires an explicitly prepared target environment.
Kubernetes deployment requires an explicitly prepared target environment.
Dataset publication requires a frozen evaluator and quality contract.
A provider experiment consumes the approved versioned dataset selected for that run.
A Kubernetes release must pass provider-specific readiness before deployment.
Only a verified packaged ref may be pushed remotely.
A pull request can be created or updated only after the intended ref exists remotely.
Remote merge consumes a fresh passing readiness decision.
An explicit deploy trigger is selected only when merge does not already start the approved deployment.
A verified review finding may produce one separately authorized provider response.
An approved local guard can protect a later push but never authorizes it.

description: Execute explicitly authorized remote deployment or configuration change.
exit_contract: one durable remote receipt or fail-closed action result; no cascaded authorization

invalidate_on: source evidence becomes stale or fails verification

gates: select only atomic steps whose trigger matches and prerequisites are current
preserve candidate permission identity and mutation scope exactly
remote, local-system, external-session, and local-git steps remain disabled without fresh current authorization
hard dependencies are current-run prerequisites; optional dependencies never force activation; feedback dependencies feed a future pass and never block current-run execution
no passed handoff without complete four-part evidence contract
human_checkpoint: human grants fresh per-action authorization for one exact target and immutable input

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Configure one provider's AI or LLM observability for exact applications and environments under explicit telemetry governance and per-action authorization.
hard_gates: AI observability may collect only explicitly governed fields at approved sampling, retention, region, and access; prompt, response, tool, user, or retrieved content is denied by default.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: AI application, traces, sensitive-data policy, provider, evaluation signals, retention, and authorization.
outputs: sampling, redaction, retention, and access record
